engine: Saisei's list-row hover — hovering a nav row: a tan highlight BAND wipes left->right across the row, a baseline UNDERLINE grows from the left, and the row's ordinal glyph FLIPS to a theme-kanji (ordinal <-> theme). The shapes are CSS (scaleX from left); JS wires the hover + kanji swap. Harvested from D_saisei (S10).

measured_teardown.move: on mouseenter add .is-hover (CSS: ::before tan band scaleX 0->1 from left + ::after underline scaleX 0->1 from left) and swap the .rwh-ordinal text to its data-kanji; reverse on mouseleave.
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei menu rows: tan band wipes L->R, underline grows from left, the circular ordinal flips to the theme-kanji (e.g. 革新 for Project).

entry: RowWipeHover.create(target, { row }) -> { destroy }. Each .rwh-row has a .rwh-ordinal with data-kanji. On hover: .is-hover (CSS wipes the band + underline) and the ordinal text swaps to the kanji.
law: CSS transform(scaleX, origin left) + opacity for the band/underline (transition); JS only toggles a class + swaps text; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL. owns_pin false.
gate_mode: hover interaction (not scroll/timeline) — the smoothness-gate doesn't apply. Verify the band wipes L->R + underline grows + the ordinal flips on hover.
proven: lab: OUR nav rows — hovering row 02 adds .is-hover, the tan band wipes L->R (scaleX 0.68 mid-transition), and the ordinal '02' flips to '革新'. Probe (4x throttle): 0% long frames, 59.9fps.
